description: This Java source file defines Swagger API documentation classes for loan transaction endpoints in the Fineract project, including response and request data structures for loan transaction operations.

classes.name: LoanTransactionsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger API documentation for loan transaction endpoints.

classes.name: GetCodeValuesDataResponse
classes.description: Response data structure for code values, including id, name, description, and position.

classes.name: GetLoansLoanIdTransactionsTemplateResponse
classes.description: Template response structure for loan transactions, including transaction type, total, amount, currency, charge off reasons, payment options, and classification.

classes.name: GetLoansTransactionType
classes.description: Represents the type of a loan transaction, with id, code, and description.

classes.name: GetLoansTotal
classes.description: Details about the total amount in a specific currency, including code, name, decimal places, symbol, and value.

classes.name: GetPaymentTypeOptions
classes.description: Payment type options with id, name, and position.

classes.name: GetLoanCurrency
classes.description: Currency details including code, name, decimal places, display symbol, and label.

classes.name: GetLoansLoanIdTransactionsTransactionIdResponse
classes.description: Response structure for a specific loan transaction, including type, currency, relation, charges, and payment details.

classes.name: GetLoansType
classes.description: Details about the type of a loan transaction, including external IDs and boolean flags.

classes.name: GetLoansCurrency
classes.description: Currency details for a loan transaction.

classes.name: GetLoanTransactionRelation
classes.description: Relation between loan transactions, including from/to transaction IDs, relation type, amount, and payment type.

classes.name: GetLoansLoanIdLoanChargePaidByData
classes.description: Data about who paid a loan charge, including ID, amount, installment, charge ID, and transaction ID.

classes.name: PostLoansLoanIdTransactionsRequest
classes.description: Request structure for posting a new loan transaction, including date, amount, note, external IDs, payment info, charge IDs, and re-age command parameters.

classes.name: PostLoansLoanIdTransactionsResponse
classes.description: Response after posting a loan transaction, including resource IDs and change details.

classes.name: PostLoansLoanIdTransactionsTransactionIdRequest
classes.description: Request structure for posting a transaction by transaction ID, including date, amount, note, and external ID.

classes.name: PutChargeTransactionChangesResponse
classes.description: Response structure for changes to a charge transaction, including updated amounts and date.

classes.name: PutChargeTransactionChangesResponseChanges
classes.description: Details of changes made to a charge transaction.

classes.name: PutChargeTransactionChangesRequest
classes.description: Request structure for updating a charge transaction, including ID and loan ID.
